relevance_note: The paper reports a family with three carriers: 'a non-previously described TNFAIP3 missense variation, c.707T>C, p.(Leu236Pro), identified in three patients from the same family'.
method_note: Built with a short Python script that transcribes Table 1 (patients as columns: I.1, II.1, II.2) and Table 2 (variants as columns; header row 'Molecular TNFAIP3 (NM_006290) anomaly'); script output was checked against both tables by eye. Scope: the family (I.1, II.1, II.2 carriers; I.2 = healthy mother of II.2, Sanger-negative, no variant row) plus the 12 previously published index cases of Table 2 (data columns 2-13; data column 1 'Current study' is proband II.2, matching onset 15 months) and the relatives named in Table 2's 'Family segregation' row. Table 2 relatives: 'sisters' (column 10) recorded as two rows (minimum implied by the plural); 'three other family members' (column 5) as three rows without sex; column 8 mother and brother were not genetically tested (no variant rows) and their 'same symptoms' were not mapped to features; 'milder symptoms'/'(mildly) symptomatic' not recorded as features; 'no symptoms' (columns 7 and 13 carriers) recorded as feature 'symptoms' excluded without excluding specific checklist items. Variant fields for Table 2 relatives (type, zygosity, pathogenicity, functional evidence) left 'not reported' (D-29). Variant type 'missense' for Table 2 index cases from the table title; zygosity not stated per column. Column 6 (p.(Leu275Pro)) is described as 'de novo variation' with 'No family history' but no parental testing is stated, so inheritance is 'not reported'. Table 1 'No' cells read as explicit absence: Musculoskeletal 'No' (II.1) excludes arthritis or arthralgia; Ocular 'No' excludes uveitis or other ocular inflammation; Hepatic 'No' excludes autoimmune hepatitis; Cardiovascular 'No' recorded only as a feature (pericarditis or other serositis and vasculitis left not reported). Table 2 Ulcers 'No' excludes oral and genital ulcers but not the composite GI item. CRP values (15/7/7 mg/L) have no reference range, so 'elevated inflammatory markers' is not reported. Group-level elevated plasma cytokines not recorded as per-person features. Long Table 2 rows (Family segregation, Treatment, Functional consequence) are quoted as the cell (or previous cell plus cell) rather than from the row label. Contradictions/inconsistencies: (1) p.(Leu236Pro) is 'of uncertain significance' by ACMG in Results but 'Likely pathogenic' in Table 2 (both recorded); (2) Table 2 Reference cell for p.(Asn102Ser) reads 'Chen et al., 2020b' (the PremPS methods paper) while the footnote and text cite Chen et al., 2020a (copied verbatim as printed); (3) p.(Leu275Pro) is 'Pathogenic' in Table 2 but 'likely pathogenic' in the text; p.(Thr602Ser) is 'Likely pathogenic' in Table 2 but 'can be considered as pathogenic' in the text (Table values recorded); (4) colchicine response for II.2 is 'partial response' in Table 2 but 'satisfactory'/'significant improvement' in the text; (5) 'Yes^&' for column 3 fever has an undefined footnote symbol. Consanguinity stated only for II.2. Supplementary files are raw western blot / flow cytometry data with no patient-level information.
